COZE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Supabase service-role key (server only — never exposed to client)

DOUBAO_API_KEY.description: Volcengine Doubao (Ark) API key for AI chat

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key for transactional email (welcome, suspend, contact). Skip silently if unset.

ADMIN_INVITE_TOKEN.description: Shared secret for /admin/register. If unset, new-admin signup returns 404. Existing admins can still create others via the dashboard.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: Canonical site URL (default: https://sica.com.cn). Used in sitemap, metadata, structured data, and email links.
